title: config/rebuild.json
description: The class of each tool of the repository, read by scripts/kit/rebuild-check.mts (S1); kit finds the tool sources by the layout of the repository and the file only classifies them (K286): ecosystem, replaced, record or policy, each with the field it needs.

tools.description: Each tool, by its path, with { kind, tool | reason | record }; rebuild-check checks the field of each kind.
